messages:
Zoe: hey team, first day here :wave: trying to run the onboarding Buildkite pipeline (redwood/onboarding-ci). it fails at the docker push step with a 401 from GHCR. anyone seen this for new joiners?
Sam: welcome! :tada: can you paste the exact build log snippet? most often it's GH org app token or packages perms.
Zoe: pasted log below:
```
Pushing to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/onboarding:latest
The push refers to repository [ghcr.io/redwood-inference/onboarding]
unauthorized: authentication required
```
Zoe: the pipeline is using the org GitHub App (redwood-ci-app) to auth the push. i haven't touched org permissions.
ci-bot: Buildkite: build #24 failed — https://buildkite.com/redwood/onboarding-ci/builds/24 (status: failed)
Devon: looks like the GH App probably doesn't have the 'packages: write' permission or you aren't in the ci-allowed team for GHCR. new users often need the org team added.
Sam: yep — two quick things to check:
1) does the 'redwood-ci-app' have Packages write (and read) in the org settings?
2) is your GitHub user in the 'ci-onboarding' team (gives package push access)?
Maureen: @Devon i can check the app scopes. Zoe, what's your GitHub username?
Zoe: @Maureen it's zoe.kim
Maureen: ok on it, re-checking org settings...
Maureen: update — GH App was missing Packages write after a recent permission audit (we tightened scopes). I granted Packages: write and re-added the ci-onboarding team to have push access to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/onboarding.
Maureen: can someone re-run the pipeline for Zoe?
Sam: re-run started: https://buildkite.com/redwood/onboarding-ci/builds/25 — triggered by @Sam
ci-bot: Buildkite: build #25 started — https://buildkite.com/redwood/onboarding-ci/builds/25
ci-bot: Buildkite: build #25 passed — https://buildkite.com/redwood/onboarding-ci/builds/25 (status: passed)
Zoe: confirmed it passed, thanks so much 🙏. what should i do if I hit this again?
Devon: if you see 401 from GHCR again, ping @infra (or @Maureen) and include the build link + your GitHub username. we usually check GH App scopes and team membership. adding a short checklist: 
- paste the build link
- include full docker push error block
- confirm your GH username
Sam: also if you're blocked by permissions during onboarding, open a ticket in #help with 'CI onboarding' tag so we can track.
Zoe: will do. thanks everyone, excited to be here :smile:
